kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نحتلم (form VIII)
# نَحْتَلِمُ (naḥtalimu) /naħ.ta.li.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
# نَحْتَلِمَ (naḥtalima) /naħ.ta.li.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
# نَحْتَلِمْ (naḥtalim) /naħ.ta.lim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
